title: Schedule of Valuables Settlement Percentages by Escalation Timing, Host Damage Protection (HostCover)
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover) valuables claims.** The valuables escalation share follows the calendar days from the date part of the guest's response deadline to the date part of the host's escalation of the valuables claim: an escalation 22 to 30 days after the deadline settles the valuables at 80 percent, one 8 to 21 days after at 90 percent, and one 7 days or fewer after in full. The percentage applies to the valuables loss being settled, before any guest payment or deductible comes off it.

| Calendar days, deadline date to escalation date | Valuables settled at |
|---|---|
| 7 or fewer | in full |
| 8 to 21 | 90 percent |
| 22 to 30 | 80 percent |

## Boundary rows (hypothetical deadline at 21:00 on 1 August)

| Host escalated on | Days | Settled at |
|---|---|---|
| 8 August, 09:00 | 7 | in full |
| 9 August, 08:00 | 8 | 90 percent |
| 22 August | 21 | 90 percent |
| 23 August | 22 | 80 percent |
| 31 August | 30 | 80 percent |

Only the date parts are compared: the 21:00 deadline time and the time of the escalation do not move the count.
